_comment: The SHORT format, under consideration -- two pools of three, then a
four-team double-elimination playoff. Nothing here is a result and
nothing here enters any ledger; it is a proposal drawn on the site so
the captains can look at it before anyone commits.
UNLIKE data/fixtures.json this file is HAND-AUTHORED. It is an input,
not an output: only the parts that cannot be worked out are written
down. The six pool matches, the four playoff boxes, who feeds which
box, the final placings and every count on the page are DERIVED by
export_web.build_mini() -- so a pool edited here redraws the whole
page and no two numbers can disagree.
Team 6 is NOT in data/teams.json on purpose: a roster row there is
what resolves a player to a team, and Team 6 is two named people and
three empty chairs. It is named here instead, display-only, so it can
appear on the bracket without becoming a name that could quietly
Set "status" to "live" once the league agrees to play it.
